parts.name: Root
parts.description: The number field container. Owns the numeric state, formatting, and validation, provides context to all parts, and renders a hidden input that submits the raw number when `name` is set.

props.name: id
props.description: Id applied to the root element. Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled numeric value. Bindable. Always a raw number; the visible text is formatted separately.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called when the committed numeric value changes.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: Intl.NumberFormat options used to format the visible input text (currency, percent, unit, fraction digits, ...).

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum allowed value.

props.name: max
props.description: Maximum allowed value.

props.name: step
props.description: Amount applied by arrow keys, stepper buttons, wheel, and scrubbing. `'any'` steps by 1 without step-based validation.

props.name: smallStep
props.description: Step applied while holding `Ctrl`/`Cmd` with the arrow keys.

props.name: largeStep
props.description: Step applied while holding `Shift` with the arrow keys.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Removes the field from interaction and focus order.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Keeps the input focusable while preventing value changes.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the input as required for form validation.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field as invalid and exposes `aria-invalid` and `data-invalid`.

props.name: aria-invalid
props.description: Overrides the computed `aria-invalid` value.

props.name: allowWheelScrub
props.description: Lets the mouse wheel step the value while the input is focused.

props.name: allowOutOfRange
props.description: Allows typed values outside `min`/`max` to be committed. When `false`, out-of-range drafts stay editable while focused and clamp on commit.

props.name: snapOnStep
props.description: Snaps stepped values to the nearest multiple of `step`.

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the hidden input that submits the raw numeric value with a form.

props.name: incrementAriaLabel
props.description: Overrides the localized accessible label of the increment button.

props.name: decrementAriaLabel
props.description: Overrides the localized accessible label of the decrement button.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while any part of the field has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-number-field-hidden-input
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the hidden native input used for form submission.

dataAttributes.name: data-number-field-root
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the root element.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-scrubbing
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer scrub is in progress.

parts.name: Group
parts.description: Groups the visible controls (input and stepper buttons) and mirrors the field state through data attributes.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-within
dataAttributes.description: Present while any part of the field has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-number-field-group
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the group element.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-scrubbing
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer scrub is in progress.

parts.name: Input
parts.description: The visible text input with role="spinbutton". Handles formatted text entry, keyboard stepping, and native validity.

props.name: element
props.description: Bindable reference to the rendered input element.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-focus-visible
dataAttributes.description: Present while focus should be visibly indicated (keyboard modality).

dataAttributes.name: data-focused
dataAttributes.description: Present while the input has focus.

dataAttributes.name: data-input-state
dataAttributes.description: Relation between the draft text and the committed value: "synced", "partial", "invalid", or "out-of-range".

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-number-field-input
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the input element.

dataAttributes.name: data-out-of-range
dataAttributes.description: Present while the current value is outside `min`/`max`.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-required
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is required.

dataAttributes.name: data-scrubbing
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer scrub is in progress.

props.name: children

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-number-field-increment

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly

parts.name: ScrubArea
parts.description: Turns its content into a pointer-drag control that steps the value while dragging.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered inside the scrub area, such as a label and `NumberField.ScrubAreaCursor`.

props.name: direction
props.description: Axis of pointer movement that changes the value.

props.name: pixelSensitivity
props.description: Pixels of pointer movement required per step.

props.name: teleportDistance
props.description: Wraps the virtual cursor after it travels this many pixels, allowing unlimited scrubbing in a bounded area.

dataAttributes.name: data-direction
dataAttributes.description: The configured scrub direction ("horizontal" or "vertical").

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-number-field-scrub-area
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the scrub area element.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-scrubbing
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer scrub is in progress.

parts.name: ScrubAreaCursor
parts.description: Optional virtual cursor rendered while scrubbing, following the pointer inside the scrub area.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered as the virtual cursor.

dataAttributes.name: data-disabled
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is disabled.

dataAttributes.name: data-invalid
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is invalid.

dataAttributes.name: data-number-field-scrub-area-cursor
dataAttributes.description: Identifies the scrub area cursor element.

dataAttributes.name: data-readonly
dataAttributes.description: Present when the field is readonly.

dataAttributes.name: data-scrubbing
dataAttributes.description: Present while a pointer scrub is in progress.
